request: Our support team is drowning. Prepare a proposal for cutting first-response time, but I haven't told you team size, ticket volume or current tools, so make sensible assumptions and state them. The budget is 'basically nothing' yet leadership also wants 24/7 coverage, which conflict: pick a trade-off and justify it. Compare at least two approaches with a costed budget, give a phased rollout with real dates, rank the main risks, and define measurable success criteria. Separate illustrative numbers from verified facts.
